content: Do not look where you fell, but where you slipped.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: When people suffer a defeat or bankruptcy, they obsess over the final crash—the floor where they landed. But the catastrophe was actually determined twenty yards upstream where their foot first encountered the slick mud. To prevent falling again, find the original slip.
practicalInsight: Trace a recent mistake back to its earliest warning sign. What subtle compromise or distraction caused the initial slip?
reflectionPrompt: What was the very first compromise that led to your last major stumble?
